justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Geriatric PT is high-need; GCS-specific outcome comparison vs non-GCS not available.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ABPTS exam plus 2,000 hours geriatric clinical experience; major career investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any geriatric PT caseload; broadly useful in SNF, home health, acute care, and geriatric outpatient.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No GCS-specific billing premium in most contracts; some health systems offer differential pay or referral preference.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Valued in geriatric, SNF, and home health PT settings; ~6,000 holders; moderate to high employer demand.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Older patients may prefer credentialed geriatric specialists.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Geriatrics skews Medicare-funded; some cash-pay potential in wellness/active-aging and concierge models.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: ABPTS specialty supports premium positioning, especially for concierge geriatric or balance-clinic models.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: GCS holders are uncommon — strong professional differentiator.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Specialty supports a clinic model around balance/falls/active-aging staffed by trained generalists.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't ask for 'GCS' but do seek balance/falls programs.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires significant clinical hours and exam; time-intensive.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: ABPTS board cert is a marquee academic credential, especially for geriatric-focused programs.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: GCS holders are heavily represented in APTA Geriatrics scholarship.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly maps to required DPT geriatrics curricular content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Built on strong, growing geriatric rehab evidence base.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently preferred/required in faculty postings covering geriatrics.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Exam path is reasonable for the academic standing gained.
